query:
UPDATE course_lessons SET content = REPLACE(content, '```
Standard Diode:          Zener Diode:           Schottky Diode:
  Anode    Cathode       Anode    Cathode       Anode    Cathode
    ─────|>|─────          ─────|>|─────          ─────|>|─────
         ▷|                    ▷|/                    ▷|⌐
                              (bent bar)           (hooked bar)
```', '```
  STANDARD DIODE          ZENER DIODE            SCHOTTKY DIODE
  Anode ──▷|── Cathode    Anode ──▷|/── Cathode   Anode ──▷|⌐── Cathode
           │                      │/                      │⌐
  (straight bar)          (bent/angled bar ends)   (hooked/curved bar)

  LED                     TVS (Bidirectional)     PHOTODIODE
  Anode ──▷|── Cathode    Cathode ──|◁▷|── Cathode  Anode ──▷|── Cathode
         ↗↗                (back-to-back)                 ↙↙
  (arrows pointing OUT)                           (arrows pointing IN)

  VARACTOR               TUNNEL DIODE            POWER/IGBT FREEWHEELING
  Anode ──▷|── Cathode   Anode ──▷|── Cathode    Anode ──▷|── Cathode
         ═══                    ├┤│               (heavy-duty package)
  (capacitor-like bar)   (step in bar)            Same symbol, rated >10A
```') WHERE id = 60013;
